description:
Found by fz-8c on the stack tip; verified 2026-11-12 on c768670cd (release, interp):

  Enum.to_list(Stream.map([fn x -> x end], fn f -> f.(1) end))

elixir prints [1]. fz2 stops at compile: error[artifact/incomplete-semantic-plan]: boxed closure call in FunctionId(69) expects delivered lane(s) [] but construction wrapper ... publishes [ValueRef]: the two halves of one calling convention were compiled against different contracts. Repro: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-j5n-Workspace-fz-xxd13-build/d6960461-b7a2-4585-a9e7-9f2477e57ee2/scratchpad/handoff/closure_elem.fz (.exs copy for elixir).

Same diagnostic family as fz-sc8.119 item 1, but no Map.new / any-returning spec is involved, so the fz-sc8.123 spec change is not expected to cure it; check it there first and fold if it does. Minimize, find the mechanism (the empty expected lane list is the lead), fixture with an oracle on all three paths.
title: A Stream.map mapper that calls a closure element compiles
